executiveSummary: Critical OT-relevant exploitation is unfolding across perimeter, virtualization, and industrial control layers. Immediate action is required to harden management planes, remove risky internet exposure, and accelerate patching on systems that bridge IT and OT. Virtualization control planes are under active attack: a vCenter Server zero-day (CVE-2026-123890) used by a China-nexus actor (UNC5221/Armory Castle) grants admin and SAML hijack, enabling rapid lateral movement to ESXi and tenant workloads. View Article Direct OT targeting: a joint U.S. advisory warns of active campaigns probing Siemens S7 PLCs using S7comm/snap7, emphasizing inventory, segmentation, and monitoring of TCP/102. Security Advisory Perimeter risk escalates with unauthenticated HTTP/2 RCE in NGINX (public PoC), affecting reverse proxies that often front ICS DMZs; temporary disablement of HTTP/2 is advised pending patches. CERT-FR Alert "Java4Shell" (CVE-2026-114938) enables RCE in Java HotSpot on AVX-512 VBMI CPUs; Java's ubiquity in middleware and appliances creates wide blast radius, including OT-adjacent gateways/services. CISA Alert OPC UA stacks: multiple Eclipse Milo weaknesses enable unauthorized method execution, info leaks, and DoS on industrial servers; apply patched releases and enforce strong OPC UA policies. CISA Bulletin Industrial devices at risk: unauth access and unsigned write surfaces in Danfoss iC7 drives, and public exploit activity against Advantech WISE-6610 LoRaWAN gateways, warrant urgent isolation and firmware updates. CISA Bulletin CISA Bulletin State-backed tradecraft persists: China-nexus covert networks leverage compromised SOHO/IoT devices for CI pre-positioning; separate joint guidance details router hygiene and LOTL detection priorities. Advisory Advisory Email and orchestration platforms in KEV: Zimbra XSS exploited by Russia-linked LAUNDRY BEAR, SonicWall SSLVPN, and Puppet Enterprise deserialization are all confirmed exploited; prioritize patching and compromise assessment. Advisory CISA KEV CISA KEV

items: UNC5221 / "Armory Castle": exploiting vCenter CVE-2026-123890; tooling (BONESAW/SAWSNAKE/LAZYBONES) focuses on SSO/SAML and ESXi enumeration; target scope includes telco and cloud backbones. View Article

descriptions: Initial Access: Exploit Public-Facing Application (T1190); Valid Accounts (T1078); Supply-chain/service abuse (reverse proxies, VPNs).
Execution & Persistence: SAML token/signing abuse (T1606.002); Web Shell (T1505.003); Service modification on appliances; DLL sideloading (Windows).
Privilege Escalation & Defense Evasion: Credential Dumping (T1003); BYOVD to kill EDR; Log deletion (T1070); Golden SAML.
Discovery & Lateral Movement: vCenter/ESXi inventory; RDP/SMB/WinRM (T1021.*); OPC UA method calls; router/SOHO pivoting (T1090).
Command & Control: Covert egress over Slack/HTTPS/DoH; Blockchain C2 (Solana memos) noted in separate criminal ops.
Impact: Hypervisor VM disruption; PLC/drive parameter tampering; data theft/extortion (double extortion models).

outlook72h: Expect automated scanning and broad opportunistic exploitation of NGINX HTTP/2 RCE where HTTP/2 remains enabled; disable and monitor for malformed frames and crashes. CERT-FR Alert Continued targeting of vCenter environments as organizations patch; post-compromise discovery for SAML/STS persistence expected. View Article Incremental increases in S7comm probes and opportunistic OPC UA method-call abuse against poorly segmented plants. Security Advisory Router/SOHO device abuse to mask reconnaissance and credential spraying against VPN/email/IdP interfaces of CI operators. Advisory
